messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished to canary group (5%): image v2.14.3 (build 2026-03-17_14:15). Monitoring for 10m.
maya: seeing elevated 5xx from canary, ~12% of requests on inference-api, latency also up.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - SLI breach: inference/resp_5xx > 10% (canary). Paging eng-oncall.
liam: oncall here, pulling logs from canary nodes now.
julian: any signs if this is model load or RPC timeouts to kvcache?
maya: stack traces show OOMs on gpu-worker-3 and intermittent model-init timeouts around the same timeframe.
alex: hypothesis: recent async prefetch change could be increasing memory pressure. Recommend disabling prefetch for canary.
maya: agreed. Toggling feature gate 'kv_prefetch' OFF for canary now.
maya: ```
# feature flag toggle
flags set kv_prefetch=false --scope=canary
```
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: kv_prefetch=false for scope=canary ✅
maya: error rate dropping to ~6% within 30s :thumbsup:
liam: still seeing some user errors; looks like the single commit that introduced the async change (sha: abc1234, PR #9823) also changed prefetch buffer sizing. Recommend revert or rollback.
julian: which is faster to restore customer experience: a one-line revert PR or rolling the canary back to previous image?
maya: rollback canary to previous image v2.14.2 now — that should be quickest. Initiating rollback.
deploy-bot: Rollback started: canary image v2.14.3 -> v2.14.2. Initiating graceful drain of new pods.
liam: watching health checks and metrics.
maya: two nodes passed healthchecks, traffic shifting back to baseline. Error rate trending down to normal.
alex: support reports 3 customers with elevated retries/tickets; no persisted data loss reported. Telemetry shows retry storms from SDK clients hitting 5xx.
carmen: drafting status page: "Intermittent 5xx errors observed during canary deploy; mitigation in progress, rollback initiated. No data loss detected." Will publish after rollback confirmed.
liam: rollback complete. Canary now at v2.14.2. Post-rollback SLI within normal bounds.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete: canary image v2.14.2 — all canary pods healthy.
maya: I'll open a hotfix PR that reverts commit abc1234 directly (simple revert) and run CI + a 30m canary test before re-rolling.
julian: if hotfix is green, recommend a cautious ramp: 1% -> 5% with additional telemetry for GPU OOM tagging and sequence-length buckets.
carmen: :white_check_mark: Status update posted to status.redwood.com and customers notified via email draft.
alex: follow-ups: create an incident ticket with root-cause hypothesis (async prefetch + memory regression at certain sequence lengths). Assign to PR author for root-cause and test coverage.
maya: assigning to @sam (author of PR) and tagging @alex for verification. Handing pager to liam for the next 2 hours.
liam: taking pager. Will escalate if we see regression after canary rerun.
ops-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Mitigation timestamp: 3245679032. Incident assignees: sam, alex, maya.
maya: brief postmortem will be scheduled; tags: postdeploy, canary, feature-gate, quick-rollback. Thanks everyone for fast coordination.
liam: closing thread from on-call unless anything else crops up.
